initial_candidates: Reduce main-search check extensions to two at profiles 50-79; preserve 0 and 100 schedules and root attack policy.
Do not train quiet-history maluses on unsearched futility/move-count-pruned moves.
If needed, test zero optional quiet checks at the default profile; retain all legal evasions and main-search checks.

screen.selection: Exploratory paired-match evidence, not fixture exactness or a depth-only proxy. Screen all independent variants before selecting. Require a positive held-out confirmation and no safety or personality regression to promote.

confirmation.policy: Do not tune using confirmation. Report intervals, faults, selection caveats and forcing/check-rate retention.
